name: Work a lead from new to first message
when: A Leads card is wired to you and a lead in New or Fit needs taking forward.
procedure: Score the lead with score_lead, following the icp-fit skill.
Write one note with note_lead: the best piece of evidence, with its link.
Draft the first message with the evidence-outreach skill, and give it to the founder in the chat.
The founder sends it. Only they move the lead to Contacted.
Five days after it was sent with no reply, draft one short follow-up. Then stop.
pitfalls: Never mark a lead contacted yourself, and never send for the founder.
Do not paste OpenOutreach's reason into a message: it is written about the lead, not to them.
One follow-up only. No reply after that is an answer.
verify: The lead has a score with a reason, one note with a link, and a draft in the chat that names the evidence.
